existing_fixes_note: No Victoria destination or spot exists in src/data yet, so nothing to move or merge. Hume Dam is not in this region. "Hamilton" (NZ) exists as destination id hamilton: the new Victorian one is id hamilton-victoria, name needs owner confirmation.

standalone_near_destinations.why_not_a_spot: Kept place inside Budj Bim NP, no destination to hold it (park has 2). 37 km from Hamilton but reached from Macarthur/Heywood.

merged_candidates.name: Great Western
merged_candidates.reason: Rule "A town is a spot only when the town itself is a draw": the town is a wrapper beside its own winery attraction. Kept place is carried by the Seppelt Great Western spot (Ararat); the town is mentioned in the Ararat description.

review_list.name: Mount Napier State Park
review_list.case: For: volcano with summit walk and lava features, Parks Victoria managed. Against: only one board source and generic text, little verified to do.

review_list.name: St Arnaud Range National Park
review_list.case: For: lookouts and walks above St Arnaud, national park. Against: one source, no verified named sight, Parks Victoria page unresolved.

review_list.name: Brambuk
review_list.case: For: Wikivoyage Grampians calls it a must-visit Aboriginal cultural centre. Against: Parks Victoria says the cultural centre is closed for refurbishment (only information centre and shop open), targeting reopening mid-2026; reopening unconfirmed. Keep if the owner confirms it has reopened.

review_list.name: Cyril Callister Vegemite Museum
review_list.case: For: quirky museum on the Vegemite inventor, named by a tourism page. Against: one source, small, opening arrangements unverified.

notes: New destinations (owner pre-approved): Grampians National Park (flagship, 24 spots), Ararat (7), Hamilton (Victoria) (4), Horsham (6). Colac, Budj Bim/Lower Glenelg and the Colac crater lakes are clusters of 2-3 kept places each (under four), so standalone. Little Desert and Kara Kara are thin parks: standalone. Silo-art stops outside Horsham reach are standalone. Candidates with no coordinates got an area hint marked pin_status=provisional; resolve-pin HIGH/MEDIUM points are pin_status=ok. All provisional pins go to the pins stage. The Stick Shed candidate note said "shearing shed": it is the Murtoa grain store, bio corrected. Mount Napier, St Arnaud Range NP, Brambuk and the Vegemite Museum are review only (not placed).
